using ull = unsigned long long;

const int MOD = 1000000007;

int n, S, cnt[250], id[250];
int f[10][250];
vector<int> vec[10];
unordered_map<ll, int> mp;

int modPow(int base, int exp) {
    int result = 1;
    base %= MOD;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) result = (1LL * result * base) % MOD;
        base = (1LL * base * base) % MOD;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

int solve(int pos, ll state) {
    if (state == 0) return 0;
    if (pos == n) return 1;
    
    ll key = (static_cast<ll>(pos) << 32) | state;
    if (mp.count(key)) return mp[key];
    
    ++S;
    int result = 0;
    
    for (int mask = 1; mask < (1 << n); ++mask) {
        ll nextState = 0;
        for (int idx = 0; idx < vec[pos].size(); ++idx) {
            if (!(state & (1LL << idx))) continue;
            int prevMask = vec[pos][idx];
            for (int bit = 0; bit < n; ++bit) {
                if ((mask & (1 << bit)) && !(prevMask & (1 << bit))) {
                    nextState |= 1LL << id[prevMask | (1 << bit)];
                }
            }
        }
        result = (result + 1LL * f[pos][mask] * solve(pos + 1, nextState)) % MOD;
    }
    
    return mp[key] = result;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    cin >> n;
    int inv100 = modPow(100, MOD - 2);
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {

            int p1 = (1LL * P * inv100) % MOD;
            int p0 = (1 + MOD - p1) % MOD;
            for (int k = 0; k < (1 << j); ++k) {
                f[i][k | (1 << j)] = (1LL * f[i][k] * p1) % MOD;
                f[i][k] = (1LL * f[i][k] * p0) % MOD;
            }
        }
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i < (1 << n); ++i) {
        cnt[i] = __builtin_popcount(i);
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i < (1 << n); ++i) {
        vec[cnt[i]].push_back(i);
        id[i] = vec[cnt[i]].size() - 1;
    }
